### Keep on Asking
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/keep-on-asking-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 7:7-8
Points:
- Prayer is meant to be a persistent, continual discipline rather than a one-time transaction.
- The Holy Spirit helps believers maintain unceasing prayer and intercedes for their deepest needs.
- God is a dependable Father who understands what His children truly need before they ask.
- The invitation to seek and receive is open to everyone because God shows no favoritism.
- Receiving the Father's generous love equips believers to treat others according to the Golden Rule.

### You Can Never Ask Too Much
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/you-can-never-ask-too-much
Passage: Matthew 7:7-12
Points:
- Jesus encourages persistent prayer by arguing that our heavenly Father is far better than flawed earthly parents.
- God never ignores the cries of His children; He provides what is requested or something better.
- A loving Father gives only what is truly beneficial and withholds requests that would cause harm.
- Believing in God’s fatherly goodness overcomes skepticism and timid hesitation in our prayers.
- Confidence that God supplies all our needs empowers us to fulfill the Golden Rule toward others.
